Acronyms:
b ... Real World Value Intercept (0040,9224)
D ... Radionuclide Total Dose (0018,1074), if D<10⁴:D=D/10⁶
FAD .... Frame Acquisition Duration (0018,9220), FAD = FAD / 10³

FRDT ... Frame Reference Datetime (0018,9151)
H ... Patient Size (0010,1020)
IBW ... ideal body weight (kg)
LBMx ... lean body mass (LBM / LBMJAMES128 / LBMJANMA; kg)
m ... Real World Value Slope (0040,9225)
P ... Pixel Data (7fe0,0010)
RPSDT ... Radiopharmaceutical Start Datetime (0018,1078)
SUVbw ... standardized uptake value (body-weight-normalized)
S ... Patient's Sex (0010,1040)
